goal: Publish one verified VII release in which every location-bearing place page shows Home, World, Region, City, Place and the complete known search-page and legacy URL systems remain correct.

intent_model.literal_request: Apply the vacation/hourly breadcrumb model to spa, events and the whole site, then fix and republish all search pages and old-to-new redirects after thorough testing.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A single trustworthy public information architecture where navigation, URL state, schema, sitemap and redirects agree without erasing previously approved work.
likely_rejections: Spa or events still shows only area
Region and city are reversed or duplicated
A crumb opens a missing search page
Old redirects were assumed instead of exhaustively validated
A local or stale candidate was called public

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory every affected world, route family, known legacy source and migrated search page.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No representative-sample claim may replace the complete stored-inventory audit.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Test the frozen candidate, publish that exact artifact, then repeat critical checks on production.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Build output alone cannot satisfy any public requirement.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Preserve every unrelated approved capability and isolate the release from blocked map work.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Changed-component inventory, before/after checks and family regression are required.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The visitor sees one predictable geographic path and can open each location level.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: No new user decision is introduced; the hierarchy only clarifies where the place belongs.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the relevant region or city results page from the breadcrumb.
preserved_depth: all search filters and availability state
all managed SEO and redirect operations

facts.claim: The current spa and event helpers choose area before location and emit one geographic crumb.
The candidate contains 3,526 known legacy sources and 2,313 migrated search pages.
Uncommitted map work exists in another worktree and is excluded.
facts.evidence: Clean isolated worktree release/v587-sitewide-breadcrumbs from e0bb2a4

assumptions.claim: A place's area and location fields represent region and city respectively when both are verified and distinct.
assumptions.validation: Audit representative and catalog-wide records; omit a level when the source does not provide it instead of inferring.

assumptions.claim: Existing managed search publications are the canonical destination registry for migrated legacy search pages.
assumptions.validation: Run publication, sitemap and redirect validators and inspect public destinations.

out_of_scope: actual booking or outbound lead submission
invariants: No 301 chain, loop or homepage catch-all
Booking, gallery, contact, review and availability behavior remain unchanged
Only the frozen tested candidate is published

requirements.statement: Every place page with verified geography renders Home, World, Region, City, Place in that order, suppressing only missing or identical levels.
Every visible geographic crumb and BreadcrumbList item use the same valid canonical destination and page identity.
Every currently known legacy URL and migrated search page remains classified, reachable through its intended status and free of unsafe redirect behavior.
requirements.source: User request and existing migration contract

requirements.statement: Search-page slugs remain lowercase ASCII, publishable pages remain in the correct sitemap and URL changes retain direct redirects.
The targeted change preserves all unrelated approved site capabilities and excludes unapproved work.
requirements.source: User instruction not to break the site

requirements.statement: The exact tested candidate is published and the affected family is reverified on the public site with rollback available.

acceptance_checks.setup: A place has distinct verified area and city values.
acceptance_checks.action: Open its detail page in each affected world.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The visible trail and JSON-LD show Home, World, Region, City, Place in order.

acceptance_checks.setup: A place is missing one level or area equals city.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The trail omits only the unavailable or duplicate level and never invents geography.

acceptance_checks.action: Open the link and inspect response, canonical, H1, search state and sitemap classification.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The ASCII URL returns the matching 200 page with consistent state and canonical.

acceptance_checks.setup: The complete stored legacy inventory is loaded.
acceptance_checks.action: Run the migration and redirect audit.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: All known sources are classified; enabled redirects are direct and valid; gone outcomes are explicit; no chain, loop or homepage catch-all exists.

acceptance_checks.setup: Hebrew, mixed or malformed slug input is submitted through UI or API.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The request is rejected and no public URL is created.

acceptance_checks.setup: A valid managed search page and any required direct redirect exist.
acceptance_checks.action: Reload administration, sitemap and public route.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The ASCII slug, publication state, canonical and redirect remain unchanged.

acceptance_checks.setup: Compare frozen candidate with baseline and blocked map worktree.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect changed files and run family regression.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Only scoped breadcrumb/search/redirect changes are included and unrelated place functions still pass.

acceptance_checks.setup: The candidate is frozen and all predeploy checks pass.
acceptance_checks.action: Record prior public version and deploy once.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Rollback identity is available and public version matches the frozen candidate.

acceptance_checks.setup: The first public verification encounters a transient or real defect.
acceptance_checks.action: Diagnose once and retry only after a causal change.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The release is either verified after a distinct fix or reported not verified without repeated blind deployment.

open_questions.question: Does the full historical old-site corpus exceed the 3,526 currently stored sources?
open_questions.resolution: Verify the complete stored union and report any unavailable external source separately; do not claim unseen historic URLs.

authorization_boundary: Code, tests, production publication and public verification are authorized. DNS cutover, external messages, real bookings and unrelated feature changes are not.
